# Compact nonlinear coefficients (rigid rotor cavity)

This note records compact exact forms for the quartic coefficients in the
Option B (L=0) effective cavity Hamiltonian.

## Definitions

Let

```
Delta_+ = omega_c + 2 B
Delta_- = omega_c - 2 B
x = Delta_- / Delta_+
```

Then the quartic coefficients scale as

```
kappa = (g^4 / Delta_+^3) * F_kappa(x)
mu    = (g^4 / Delta_+^3) * F_mu(x)
nu    = (g^4 / Delta_+^3) * F_nu(x)
```

Define the palindromic polynomial operator

```
Pal_{2m}[a0,...,am](x) = a0 + a1 x + ... + am x^m + a_{m-1} x^{m+1} + ... + a0 x^{2m}.
```

## kappa

```
kappa = (16 g^4 / Delta_+^3) * (c01^4 p_kappa(x) + c01^2 c12^2 q_kappa(x))
        / (x^2 (5-x)^5 (x+2)^2 (2x+1)^2 (5x-1)^6)
```

```
p_kappa(x) = sum_{i=0}^{16} p_i x^i
q_kappa(x) = sum_{i=1}^{15} q_i x^i

## mu

```
mu = (128 g^4 / (531441 Delta_+^3))
     * (c01^4 P_mu(x) + c01^2 c12^2 Q_mu(x))
     / (x^3 (1-x)^11 (5-x)^10 (x+2)^2 (2x+1)^2 (5x-1)^10)
```

```
P_mu(x) = Pal_{38}[p_mu](x)
Q_mu(x) = x * Pal_{36}[q_mu](x)

```
nu = -(16 g^4 / (387420489 Delta_+^3))
     * (c01^4 P_nu(x) + c01^2 c12^2 Q_nu(x))
     / (x^3 (5-x)^12 (1-x)^17 (5x-1)^12)
```

P_nu(x) = Pal_{44}[p_nu](x)
Q_nu(x) = x * Pal_{42}[q_nu](x)

## Structural notes

- P_mu(x) and P_nu(x) are palindromic: P(x) = x^m P(1/x).
- Q_mu(x)/x and Q_nu(x)/x are palindromic.
- There is no further nontrivial common-factor cancellation with the denominators.
